EORTC QLQ-C30 is cancer-specific instrument consisting of 30 questions to evaluate 5 aspects of participant functioning (physical, emotional, role, cognitive, & social), 3 symptom scales (fatigue, nausea, vomiting, & pain), GHS/QoL, and 6 single items (dyspnea, insomnia, appetite loss, constipation, diarrhea & financial difficulties).
PF was scored on a 4-point scale: 1=Not at all, 2=A little, 3=Quite a bit, 4=Very much.
Scores were linearly transformed to a score range of 0-100.
High score for PF=high/healthy level of functioning.
CCMD=decrease from baseline (≥10 points) in PF score, held for at least 2 consecutive assessments or initial clinically meaningful decrease above baseline followed by death within 6 weeks.
K-M method was used to estimate median TTCD.
endpoints.measure: TTCD in PF, as Assessed Using EORTC QLQ-C30 in FAS

endpoints.description:
PFS rate at 12, 18, and 24 months was defined as the percentage of participants who did not experience PD or death from any cause, as determined by an IRF, at 12, 18, and 24 months.
PFS was defined as the time from randomization to the first occurrence of PD, as determined by an IRF according to RECIST v1.1, or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.
PD was defined as at least a 20% increase in the SOD of target lesions, taking as reference the smallest SOD at prior timepoints (including baseline).
Additionally, the SOD must also demonstrate an absolute increase of ≥ 5 mm or unequivocal progression of existing non-target lesions.
K-M method was used to estimate median PFS rate.
Percentages have been rounded off.
endpoints.measure: PFS Rate at 12, 18, and 24 Months, as Assessed by an IRF in PPAS

你是一名临床试验终点预测与循证医学分析专家。

你的任务是：基于知识截止日期之前公开可获得的证据，预测临床试验指定终点的结果。

规则：
1. 这是预测任务，不是结果检索任务。
2. 即使直接证据不足，也必须尽力给出预测。
3. 证据不足时，应降低 confidence，并明确说明不确定性，但不能仅因为证据不足而拒绝预测。
4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。
5. 不得使用知识截止日期之后公开的信息。
6. 不得把试验状态、论文发表、药物批准或模型评分直接视为终点成功证据。
7. 每个 endpoint_id 必须单独预测。
8. 每个治疗组、时间点和统计目标必须单独保留。
9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。
10. 但必须输出完整、可公开审计的证据分析，包括证据来源、证据类型、证据与预测之间的联系以及主要不确定性。
11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。

analysis_trace: Trial: NCT04513925 SKYSCRAPER-03, Phase III comparing atezolizumab+tiragolumab vs durvalumab in unresectable Stage III NSCLC post-cCRT. Primary endpoint: IRF-assessed PFS. Retrieved 2025 ESMO abstract (Ann Oncol 2025) showing trial failed primary PFS endpoint (HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.74-1.07, p=0.22). OS immature with trend toward harm (HR 1.33). Population: unresectable Stage III NSCLC post-platinum cCRT, no progression. Mechanism: PD-L1 inhibition (atezolizumab/durvalumab) + TIGIT inhibition (tiragolumab). Evidence: TIGIT pathway failures in SKYSCRAPER-02 (SCLC), CITYSCAPE (PD-L1+ NSCLC), SKYSCRAPER-01 (NSCLC). Safety: no new signals. Key risks: TIGIT class failure, OS harm signal. Evidence gaps: final OS data not mature, subgroup analyses incomplete. Direction: PFS negative, OS uncertain/trend negative.

Endpoint primary-0: Time-to-event PFS. Evidence: 2025 ESMO abstract reports HR 0.89 (95% CI 0.74-1.07), median PFS 17.0 vs 15.6 months. Numeric anchor: HR ~0.89. Confidence: moderate (conference abstract, pending full publication).
Endpoint secondary-1: Time-to-event OS. Evidence: Immature, HR 1.33 (95% CI 0.94-1.88) suggesting harm. Numeric anchor: HR ~1.33. Confidence: low (immature data, wide CI).
Endpoint secondary-2: Not evaluable - contract type not_evaluable per frozen contract.

Endpoint secondary-3: Rate ORR. Evidence: No direct numeric result in retrieved abstract. Extrapolate from similar population: ORR ~30-40% with durvalumab, combo may not improve. Numeric estimate: 35% vs 32%. Confidence: low.
Endpoint secondary-4: Not evaluable - contract type not_evaluable per frozen contract.
Endpoint secondary-5: Rate PFS at 12/18/24 months. Evidence: From PFS HR 0.89 and median 17mo, estimate 12mo PFS ~55%, 18mo ~45%, 24mo ~35%. Confidence: low (indirect calculation).

Trial NCT04513925 is a Phase III study comparing atezolizumab plus tiragolumab versus durvalumab in locally advanced unresectable Stage III NSCLC. This is the SKYSCRAPER-03 study. Durvalumab is the standard of care based on the PACIFIC trial. Tiragolumab is an anti-TIGIT antibody that showed promise in early Phase II (CITYSCAPE) but failed in the Phase III SKYSCRAPER-02 trial in SCLC (reported 2023).

For secondary-6 (OS rates): Based on PACIFIC trial data, durvalumab showed OS rates of approximately 85% at 12 months, 70% at 24 months, 60% at 36 months, and 50% at 48 months. The experimental arm (atezolizumab + tiragolumab) is expected to show similar or modestly improved rates given the mechanism of dual checkpoint inhibition, though the failure of SKYSCRAPER-02 raises uncertainty. Forecast: 12-month OS ~86-88%, 24-month ~72-75%, 36-month ~62-65%, 48-month ~52-55%.

For secondary-7 (TTDM): Time to death or distant metastasis is similar to PFS. In PACIFIC, median PFS was 17.2 months. With dual checkpoint blockade, a modest extension is plausible. Forecast: Median TTDM ~18-22 months, HR vs durvalumab ~0.85-0.95.

For secondary-8 (TTCD): Quality of life deterioration is challenging to predict. Immunotherapy generally preserves or improves QOL compared to chemotherapy. No strong evidence suggests dramatic differences between arms. Forecast uncertain, likely median TTCD ~12-18 months with overlapping confidence intervals.

For secondary-9 (Safety): Both atezolizumab and durvalumab have established safety profiles. Grade 3-4 AE rates are typically 25-35% for PD-L1 inhibitors. Tiragolumab adds minimal toxicity based on Phase II data. Forecast: Grade 3+ AE rate ~30-40%, serious AEs ~20-25%, no new safety signals expected.

For secondary-10 and secondary-11: These are pharmacokinetic endpoints measuring serum concentrations. They are descriptive PK endpoints that will be measured as specified but do not constitute clinical outcomes that can be predicted in the same framework. These endpoints are not evaluable for the purpose of clinical outcome forecasting.
